steps.what: Determine the actual personnel, supplies, equipment or repair requirement
Find the needed resource specification and approved requisition route
Enter the needed resource details in the existing requisition form
Check the final resource requisition for correct specification, quantity and route
Submit the needed resource requisition to the existing purchasing authority
Save the resource requisition in the same form

tasks.design: Link approved resource specifications and asset details to native {PROCUREMENT} request forms. The supervisor verifies the actual need and complete request before a separate submission to purchasing; no purchase or hiring approval is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Asset references and specifications are repeatedly searched and typed into requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue links and repeat-request forms remove clerical repetition.
tasks.still_hard: The right repair or resource depends on the actual operating problem.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a genuine operational need from an unsuitable replacement request.

ambition.what: The supervisor gains no purchasing or hiring authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalogue-linked requisition forms can reduce reference copying while need determination and purchasing authority remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual operational resource request, represented by supplies, equipment or repair; personnel requests use the actual staffing route rather than a fictitious procurement purchase. No supplier order is included.

Maintenance maintains asset id and part compatibility; purchasing maintains catalogue code, unit and request route. The supervisor establishes quantity, need and urgency in s1 and captures missing fields in retained s3 work.

s2 removes five units of catalogue navigation. s3 removes nine units of repeated asset and reference details, retaining twenty-one for actual need, quantity, urgency and checks. Ordinary save is tiny, fully retained and ungated.

s4 authorizes exact delivery of a request for another authority's decision, not approval of the request itself. Changed fields or routing void it. Existing native submission runtime earns no labour benefit.
unknowns: Which request routes require actual separate submission work
How much reference entry is already prefilled
research_questions: Can reused asset details be checked against the current equipment variant?

already_counted.description: Establish need, read specifications, complete and check the request and save

incremental.description: Repair catalogue links, stale asset references and failed request routing

approvals.approved_version: Exact resource request fields and purchasing destination checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R82 gross18 minus upkeep3 gives15. An unusual repair requires full catalogue work25 and almost bespoke request entry28 of30; need25, check15 and save1 stay. R94 gross6 minus upkeep3 gives3, including the actual four-unit request handoff.

steps.what: Read operational evidence relevant to proposed improvement measures
Discuss and recommend measures to improve work methods and service
Write the actual improvement trial plan and intended checks
Implement the agreed work-method improvement with the team and observe its effect
outputs: observed trial of improved work method

tasks.design: Configure an existing operational view in {OPS_SYSTEM} and reuse the operator's real trial-plan headings in {PROJECT}. The supervisor and team choose and implement a modest work-method improvement and observe its practical effect.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence is spread over operational screens and trial plans repeat stable context.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and plan templates remove repeated navigation and formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Motivation and service problems rarely have a purely numerical cause.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to the team, understand incentives and adapt the trial to actual conditions.

ambition.what: Compare another small work-method trial after seeing the first result.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: operational views and working-plan templates can reduce clerical effort, but choosing and implementing effective improvements requires local judgement.

assumptions: Representative episode is a reversible work-method trial within existing supervisory authority, such as simplifying the handover sequence, not a machinery, safety procedure or employment-policy change. Those changes require their actual engineering or personnel approval route before implementation.

The actual working plan is used by the supervisor to organize the trial; no extra progress report is invented. Operational staff produce the existing job and service records through normal work, and the supervisor reads source records when view fields are missing.

s1 removes three units of view switching, retaining seventeen of evidence review. s3 removes three units of repeated plan headings and context, retaining seventeen for actual trial design and checks. Ordinary save within s3 is negligible and unchanged.
No employee scoring, new monitoring feed, formal message or operative system commit is promised. Physical discussion and implementation keep their full time.
unknowns: Whether a working trial plan exists today
Which measures lie within actual supervisory authority
research_questions: Does the grouped evidence show causes rather than only activity counts?

already_counted.description: Read evidence, discuss the approach, write the actual plan and implement the trial

incremental.description: Maintain evidence views and plan references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R94 gross6 minus upkeep2 gives4. For a novel problem with no reusable plan context, source reading retains18 of20 and plan writing20 of20; discussion30 and implementation30 stay. R98 gross2 less upkeep2 gives0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture and check the actual work activity, production or accident facts for the report
Compile work activity and production figures into report tables
Prepare the written report narrative from checked facts and notes

loop.purpose: Draft a source-linked factual operations narrative
loop.input: Checked report facts, notes and deterministic tables
loop.output: Narrative distinguishing observations from unconfirmed accounts
loop.check: Supervisor checks every event, chronology, causal statement and figure against sources; no blame or cause is inferred
loop.stop: Conflicting accounts or unsupported statements require manual writing; at most one redraft
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables cannot express irregular events and witness accounts

steps.what: Check and authorize the final work or accident report for its actual recipient
Submit the checked work report to its designated internal recipient
Save the report in the existing document location

tasks.design: Generate source-linked tables from {OPS_SYSTEM} and use a bounded loop for the factual narrative in {DOCS}. The supervisor captures missing facts and checks the complete final report before {EMAIL} submits the exact version to the designated internal recipient.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operational figures and notes are manually assembled into recurring report formats.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic tables and constrained drafting can share source references without treating generated prose as evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Accident accounts may conflict and establishing cause needs an actual investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Separate verified events from uncertainty and take responsibility for the submitted account.

ambition.what: Provide a source-linked operational exception summary alongside the ordinary report.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: operational report tables can be generated from existing records, while event narratives require source-based semantic review before submission.

assumptions: Boundary is an internal work, production or incident report and its real submission. Statutory external accident notification is a distinct action with its actual authority and deadline, not silently replaced by internal delivery.

Operators produce job id, dates, output quantities, units and exception codes through normal operations. The supervisor produces observations and captures witness accounts in s1; extraction and missing-field repair are counted there and in incremental upkeep.

s2 replaces actual manual compilation, not existing machine runtime. Native report queries are tested first. Missing units, incompatible categories or broken source links stop generation for funded manual repair.
s4 checks the complete final report and recipient after narrative editing. Any revision voids submission authorization. The ordinary same-system save is tiny, ungated and earns no saving.
unknowns: Actual report source formats and manual compilation today
Which incidents need independent investigation or regulatory notification
research_questions: Does every generated statement preserve uncertainty and trace to an actual source?

already_counted.description: Capture and verify actual facts, review narrative meaning, check final report and save

incremental.description: Repair incompatible source fields, failed submissions and narrative exceptions; maintain report mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report, attachments, source references and internal recipient checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R56 gross44 less upkeep5 gives39. For an irregular accident account with incompatible source categories, table compilation retains24 of30 and narrative25 of25; capture20, final review20 and save1 stay. R90 gross10 less upkeep5 gives5, including only the actual four-unit internal submission saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Receive emergency reports by telephone or radio and clarify the situation
Capture the actual emergency location and reported needs in the dispatch log
Read available personnel and vehicles for the emergency response
Choose personnel and vehicles appropriate to the emergency
Check the exact emergency dispatch instruction, crew readiness and destination
Dispatch personnel and vehicles by radio and confirm the instruction was understood
Update the actual emergency dispatch log with crew acknowledgement and response status

tasks.design: Configure a direct availability view and reuse the existing incident identifier in the {OPS_SYSTEM} dispatch log. Emergency assessment, crew selection and acknowledged radio dispatch through {TELEPHONY} remain human, with a current exact-instruction readiness check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability requires some screen switching and log updates repeat incident identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dispatch views and linked incident entries remove small clerical costs without automating emergency judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Reports are incomplete and readiness can change immediately.
tasks.human_edge: Prioritize under uncertainty and ensure the crew understands the actual emergency.

ambition.what: Emergency command and dispatch rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked incident forms can reduce identifier entry, but emergency assessment and acknowledged operational dispatch need current human judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's actual emergency dispatch process and existing log, used for incident handover and response coordination. No invented routine emergency report or new tracking feed is added.

The caller produces incident facts; s2 counts supervisor capture of location and reported needs. Existing roster owners maintain crew, qualifications, vehicle and availability. The supervisor verifies current readiness rather than assuming a live clean feed.

s3 removes one unit of screen navigation, retaining nine of reading. s7 removes one unit of repeated incident identifiers, retaining nine for acknowledgement and actual status entry. Same-system save is negligible, ungated and unchanged.

s5 is a real current dispatch readiness decision, not an approval of the author's log. Any changed crew, destination, instruction or incident condition voids it and requires a new immediate check. Dispatch itself remains fully retained.
unknowns: Whether an actual dispatch log exists in this operation
Whether availability is already shown beside the incident
research_questions: Does identifier reuse save entry without obscuring unverified status?

already_counted.description: Receive and capture facts, read availability, decide and check the response, dispatch and record actual status

incremental.description: Maintain incident form links and availability references

approvals.approved_version: Exact crew, vehicle, location and emergency instruction checked against current readiness in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R98 gross2 minus upkeep1 gives1. If availability requires full manual checking and the incident reference is unusual, s3 retains10 of10 and s7 retains9 of10. Gross1 minus upkeep1 gives0; capture, judgement and radio work retain their full time.
